title.text: The sales of the two machines

runs.text: Each machine starts with 10 cans and charges 3 pesos per can. Read machine numbers, 1 or 2, one per sale, until a 0. A sale at a machine without cans is not made and is reported with
with their cans and money, as in the lesson:

hints.text: How many objects are needed? What decides which one is asked for the sale?
Create two machines; in the loop, the number read chooses which one to ask for
While the number is not 0, if it is 1 sell at the first one and otherwise at the second; at the end show both states. Close with the variant.

runs.text: and a code 3 that loads 5 cans into the machine with fewer.
Hidden cases: sales at a single machine, a machine that runs out of cans (the two extra sales only report) and alternating sales.
